prohibited_inferences: Do not treat this synthetic fixture as evidence about Electric Twin, News UK, Dentsu, or any named deployment.
Do not infer that a 60/40 observed split identifies a 60/40 latent first-choice distribution.
Do not infer that a high model-to-behavior match identifies the mechanism producing the behavior.
Do not infer manipulative intent from observational equivalence.
Do not infer that an unobserved option has zero demand.
Do not infer public authorization from predictive agreement.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A deterministic synthetic control showing that three distinct latent preference worlds and unavailable-option mechanisms can produce the same aggregate observed choices under the same offered option set.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A real deployment finding, a proof that any named system hides preferences, evidence of preference manipulation, or a universal behavioral model.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: This fixture proves non-identifiability from aggregate behavior alone: the same observed 60/40 choice split is compatible with several materially different latent first-choice distributions and response mechanisms.
